workload.name: raytrace-private-class-fields
workload.outputGrid: 20 by 20 from original 100 by 100 dimensions and 5 by 5 pixel size
workload.scene: Original camera, background, two spheres, plane, two lights, all material/lighting/reflection options and ray depth 2
workload.originalValidation: Engine.renderScene requires checkNumber === 2321 after each render
workload.lifecycle: One stateless Benchmark instance outside work; each runIteration creates all 15 original scenes and Engines inside work

evidence.scope: Original author, Google standalone adaptation, JetStream class-field rewrite attribution
Apple 2007-2024 BSD-2-Clause notice for JetStream modifications

adaptations.detail: Every original class/member is retained. Existing initializers, including null and empty object/array literals, remain runtime initializers. An erased Material.getColor overload permits the original two-argument virtual calls while retaining the original zero-parameter implementation and function length.

Nullable fields retain null unions. requireValue returns the exact same non-null object or throws TypeError before the original dereference/vector use. No fallback vector, material, scene, or algorithm is introduced. Guards before vector calls can move the invalid-input failure to the call site; ordinary benchmark calls never trigger them.
The four comparisons of nullable IntersectionInfo.distance use ?? 0, preserving JavaScript numeric null coercion.

Engine retains its original {} initializer and uses Partial<EngineOptions>. Optional numeric reads use ?? NaN to preserve undefined arithmetic. The two constructor compound divisions are expanded to assignments over the same original object, operands and order. Supplied benchmark options/defaults are unchanged.

After each original 2321 assertion, three scalar observations record the check number, mix it with unsigned multiply-by-31, and increment the completed-render count. work resets only these adapter counters and repeats complete original Benchmark iterations. No pixel collection or added pixel traversal occurs in production.

validation.instrumentation: Untouched source executes first. Separate test-only contexts add pixel capture and Color component access; another context wraps field initializers to record their original values/order. Production ports contain none of these hooks.

timing.protocol: Unmodified benchmarks/common/bench.mjs; 5 sequential fresh processes, best of 5 calibrated trials in each process.
